credits.title: Costanera
credits.overview: Diego is a talented but restless young trumpeter who decides to leave Rome—and his girlfriend, Alice—behind to join his mentor, Nacho, in Argentina. However, on the other side of the world, neither contracts nor certainty about the future await him, and the journey soon proves to be more existential than professional.

credits.title: Mi Pequeño Chet Baker
credits.overview: Diego, a young trumpet player, trying to escape from reality, leaves home and begins a dream throughout the night, which will lead him to encounter people from his past life who will try to bring him back to his world, but also new people who will take him to unfamiliar places.

credits.title: Houseparty
credits.overview: 4 tiktokers. A limou. A party. A dead man.
